findings.finding: The year-end ARR guide of $148-150M needs +$15.3-17.3M of net new ARR in H2 (about $7.7-8.7M a quarter) from $132.7M at June 30. Q2 added +$5.4M, and Q1 added about +$7.0M (Q1-end ARR about $127.3M). On guide pace, Q3 ARR should print about $140-141M; a print near $138M (Q2's pace) would put the ARR guide visibly at risk. ARR growth (20%) is also running below unit growth (~30%) as the mix moves to purchase subscriptions (60% of new deployments).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-08-11 the company raised only the low end of the ARR guide (to $148-150M, from $145-150M) and the stock fell 5.14% despite a revenue raise. On 2026-05-12 it fell 13.51%. The Earnings Whispers preview names ARR as one of two Q3 tests.
findings.why_not_priced: The sell-side preview flags ARR as a watch item but does not do the quarterly arithmetic; the revenue consensus (~$46M) is set at guide pace while nobody publishes a Q3 ARR consensus. If the market had priced a back-end-loaded ARR miss, the stock would be holding no premium to the guide, and it is at 52-week-low territory already, which partly reflects it.
findings.independence: Same company document as the bar. The preview (https://finviz.com/news/414444/evolvs-raised-outlook-meets-a-skeptical-street-as-margins-and-arr-face-third-quarter-test) independently says ARR growth must close the gap with unit growth. Offsets: management cited renewals and an eXpedite price increase; NRR is above 100%.

findings.finding: Gross margin is capped near 51% (Q2 GAAP 50.2%, adjusted 51.2%, below the mid-50s target). Management quantified a ~0.5pt headwind from component and supply-chain costs, just under 1pt from Gen1-to-Gen2 upgrades, and more pressure from the 60% purchase-subscription mix, and guided H2 gross margin 'consistent'. The guided H2 adjusted EBITDA ($6.6-7.6M, against $8.4M in H1) implies lower H2 margins. Memory prices kept rising through 2026: TrendForce, as reported in September 2026, puts cumulative 2026 server DRAM contract increases at ~270%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Gross margin has been flat at ~51% for the quarters cited; the stock fell on the two 2026 prints (-13.51%, -5.14%) where margins stayed below target.
findings.why_not_priced: The headwind is mostly inside what management guided (H2 GM consistent, EBITDA $15-16M), so it is largely priced. Only a further step-up in component cost since August, which management has not confirmed, is unpriced. If the market priced a GM break below 50%, the preview would carry it as the base case, and it carries it only as a risk.
findings.independence: The memory-price series is a macro proxy, not confirmed by the company for Q3: https://gamesbeat.com/memory-chip-prices-soar-up-to-90-in-q1-2026-counterpoint/ . findings.finding: The Q3 revenue bar (~$45.7-46.5M) sits in the lower half of the guide-implied H2 run rate ($45-47.5M a quarter), and the company has beaten and raised revenue in every 2026 quarter (FY guide raised from $172-178M in March to $175-180M, then $180-185M in August). Q3 is seasonally strong: in 2025 revenue went from $32.5M (Q2) to $42.9M (Q3), +32% sequentially, on school and football-season installs. Consensus implies only +6% from Q2 2026's $43.8M, while the purchase mix (product revenue recognised up front) rose to 60%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats have been sold. On 2025-11-13 a beat-and-raise traded +5.93% after hours (https://www.itiger.com/news/1151027869) and closed the session -8.81%. A raise on 2026-08-11 was -5.14%; 2026-05-12 was -13.51%. Only 2026-03-10 (+9.52%) and 2025-08-14 (+5.16%) paid.
findings.why_not_priced: The street's FY revenue estimate (~$177.8M per the preview) sits below the company's $180M low end, so consensus is either stale or doubts the guide; a print at guide pace is a modest beat. Q1 2026 ($46.3M) was above Q2, so the 2025 seasonal jump may not repeat in the same shape, which is why this is small.

lessons_applied: Lesson 1 and 'two findings, one line': merged the draft's revenue-track-record (+0.5) and Q3-seasonality (+0.7) findings into one reported-quarter finding at +0.5, because both rest on the Q3 revenue outcome and this name has sold three of its last four beats.
